Our client is a globally recognised technology group with a long heritage of developing advanced electronic systems and software solutions for critical infrastructure, secure communications, test & measurement, and cybersecurity markets.


The Dresden location is an important corporate R&D centre specialising in software development for digital signal processing, distributed system platforms, and integration with complex hardware and software ecosystems.
